output.evaluation_note: The Vietnamese expression 'phàn nàn' is primarily a verb ('to complain'), but it is commonly used nominally to refer to the act of complaining or a general complaint, especially when clarified by context or definition. The provided definition 'Sự bày tỏ sự không hài lòng...' (The act of expressing dissatisfaction...) perfectly captures this nominal sense, aligning it semantically with the English noun 'complaint' and Japanese '苦情'. All three expressions are natural, common, and share the same general register.
